eps.ov: What begins as a vacation for our hero on Melemele Island in the Alola region turns into the promise of many, many exciting adventures to come!
eps.oa: ما يبدأ عطلة لبطلنا «ساتوشي» في جزيرة «ميليميلي» بإقليم «ألولا» يتحول إلى وعد بمغامرات كثيرة مثيرة قادمة!

eps.ov: Ash and Pikachu are adjusting to life in the Alola region-and it's about to give them a powerful push in a new direction!
eps.oa: يتأقلم «ساتوشي» و«بيكاتشو» مع الحياة في إقليم «ألولا»، والإقليم على وشك أن يدفعهما دفعة قوية في اتجاه جديد!

eps.ov: Ash's journey in the Alola region is just getting under way, and our hero has a new partner to share it with!
eps.oa: رحلة «ساتوشي» في إقليم «ألولا» بدأت للتو، وصار لبطلنا رفيق جديد يشاركه فيها!

eps.ov: Ash is after his first Pokémon in the Alola region, and the adventure that ensues is typical Ash!
Ash's Pokémon class is off to the sea for some fishing, but Team Rocket has a completely different kind of fishing in mind!
Ash's first day off from Pokémon School was supposed to be a relaxing break, but things don't go quite as expected!

eps.t: That's Why the Litten Is a Scamp!
eps.ov: A feisty Litten is determined to steal food from others, and Ash and Pikachu are determined to find out why!
Lillie has a Pokémon Egg to care for until it hatches, but will fear get in her way?
Ash wants a new Z-Crystal, but he must face some formidable tasks first!
The Melemele Island grand trial is imminent, and Ash must square off against the power and wisdom of Kahuna Hala!
Ash has time off from school for training, but a fellow student's activities away from school have our hero wanting to find out all about it!

eps.t: The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!
eps.ov: While our heroes enjoy a class on the beach, familiar and unfamiliar troubles are brewing behind the scenes!
An Alolan tradition whets everyone’s appetite for fun, and Ash decides to join in!
The time has come for Lillie to address her fears, and having a new friend is the perfect way to do it!
Rockruff's current behavior may be a mystery, but Ash and Professor Kukui are determined to get to the bottom of it!
Team Rocket has their eyes on our heroes' Pokémon, but a mysterious third Pokémon has a different idea!
There's a mystery that needs solving, and there's also a surprising sleuth who's determined to solve it!
Our heroes are hungry indeed, but a quest to find the missing ingredient is keeping them that way!
Ash is looking for a very important rematch, and his training regimen is breaking new ground!
A pleasant day trip for our heroes turns into an unforgettable adventure!
The ending of one chapter in the life of a determined Pokémon ushers in the beginning of a brand-new one!
A day at the beach offers up our heroes much more than they bargained for!
A major force in Alolan popular music is in the verge of collapse!
It's the Open House day at the Pokémon School, and a surprising group of people has gathered for all the fun!
There's a Z-Crystal ripe for the picking, but are the unlikely pickers up to the task?
Moving to a new place and a new life can be stressful for anyone, and the Pokémon School gang is no exception!
A powerful Trainer has recently appeared on Melemele Island, and Ash can’t wait to find out everything about him!

eps.t: Pulling Out the Pokémon Base Pepper!
eps.ov: It’s Pokémon Base season in Alola, and the Pokémon School gang can’t seem to get enough of it: even playing against the enemy!
A Pokémon School camping trip, complete with a scary campfire story, makes for an experience our heroes will never forget!
An unusual assignment at the Pokémon School gives our heroes a surprising opportunity to learn, grow, and have fun at the same time!
Our heroes are preparing for a field trip on Akala Island, and the island kahuna promises to make it a trip to remember!
It's a new day for the Pokémon School field trip, and our heroes are preparing for an adventure they will treasure forever!
Our heroes are busy with extracurricular activities on Akala Island, and Ash and Lana are in for a great adventure!
The Wela Fire Festival is just starting to heat up, but someone seems determined to put it out!
Our heroes are embarking on a mission filled with good taste...and a surprising finish!
The time for Ash's grand trial with Olivia is finally here, and it's no ordinary battle!
As if Ash's victory at his grand trial wasn't monumental enough, an unexpected transformation makes a memorable field trip even more momentous!
When Mimikyu faces a fashion problem, Jessie sees a bonding opportunity!
It's a challenging day for Mallow and her family restaurant, and emotions are running high!
Lana and Popplio are working hard to master their Z-Move, but their progress is soon to grow by leaps and bounds!
Three of our heroes are teaming up for the annual Charjabug race, an electrifying event with shocking results!
A celebratory Pokémon School class trip turns out to be a reunion no one will ever forget!
The Cerulean Gym is the setting for old and new friends, battling old and new skills!
A vivid dream has set our hero on a mission to find out its true meaning!

eps.t: Now You See Them, Now You Don't!
eps.ov: As our heroes get to know Nebby better, Nebby gets to know them better, too!
While our heroes explore one part of Aether Paradise, Team Rocket is busy exploring another!
Ash and his friends are off on another big adventure, thanks to Nebby's amazing powers!
A sleepover at Professor Kukui's house sets the stage for fun, friendship, and unexpected adventure!
Lillie is on a mission to put her past behind her once and for all!
Although Faba's original sinister plot has been foiled, he isn't about to give up on his dream!
Lusamine has been captured by an Ultra Beast and swept away through an Ultra Wormhole, but everyone is determined to get her back safely!
Our heroes are determined to rescue Lusamine, and help is coming from unexpected and astounding sources!
Our heroes are determined to rescue Lusamine from inside the Ultra Wormhole, but Lusamine has other ideas!
Our heroes are doing everything they can to save Lusamine from an Ultra Beast...while Lusamine is doing everything she can to stop them!
Professors Kukui and Burnet are getting married, and our heroes know just what to do to help!
Our heroes are wondering about Komala's sleep patterns when they're interrupted by a familiar visitor!
Rotom Dex embarks on an electrifying journey-whether it wants to or not!
n accidental encounter with the past puts the present and future in jeopardy!

eps.t: Tasting the Bitter with the Sweet!
eps.ov: A distant memory shared by Mallow and Lana is rekindled in a bittersweet way!

eps.t: Getting a Jump on the Competition!
eps.ov: A trip to Mount Lanakila gives our heroes the opportunity to learn and grow in ways they hadn't imagined!
The appearance of another Ultra Beast compels our heroes to take on new roles-and take charge!
An unexpected appearance by a cunning visitor is turning Team Rocket's world on its head!
The appearance of a popular Alolan battling duo brings out some surprising fiery determination!

eps.t: Satoshi and Nagetukesaru! Touchdown of Friendship!!
eps.ov: Ash takes a trip to the marketplace and meets the local group of Passimians, who have a rivalry with the Akala Island Passimians.
A visit by a surprise Pokémon School graduate dazzles our heroes with the stuff of legends!
Pokémon School graduate Ilima teaches our heroes about an activity that's near and dear to his heart!
Our heroes are about to welcome an unexpected addition into the family-unexpected in so many delightful ways!
Nurse Joy is feeling a bit under the weather today, but we know just the heroes to help her out!
A potential disaster threatens the future of the Alola region, but the Ultra Guardians are ready, willing, and able to deal with it!
The survival of Kiawe's family farm may be at stake, but our heroes are up to the challenge!
There are lots of interesting Pokémon for our heroes to discover in Alola, and the one they meet today is no exception!
There's a big baking competition coming up in Alola, and a surprising participant is joining in on the fun!

eps.t: Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?
eps.ov: Team Rocket appears to be stuck in a rut, but solutions can come from high places!
A series of smaller trials line the pathway to Ash's goal-a grand trial!
Ash is determined to train with Tapu Bulu, and Tapu Bulu is determined to be as unpredictable as ever!
Ash and Pikachu are all set for their pre-trial rematch against the island kahuna, but Nanu has a different idea!
Ash's grand trial on Ula'ula Island is in full swing, and the kahuna has lots of twists and turns in store for the battle!
The Ultra Guardians are being called upon again, but this time, they're on double duty!
Our heroes are stargazing, little suspecting the spectacle that awaits them in the night sky!
A surprising show of determination leads to a happy outcome for many-in many different ways!
The Battle Royal Dome is ablaze with battling excitement, but this time the Masked Royal has a little help!

eps.t: All They Want to Do Is Dance, Dance!
eps.ov: A rousing Pokémon School class project has everyone out of their chairs, and out on the floor!
When Faba appoints himself professor for the day at the Pokémon School, an unexpected event shows that big adventures can come in small packages!

eps.t: The Shape of Love to Come!
eps.ov: Our heroes have met an astoundingly talented artist, but there's much more to her and her partner than meets the eye!
Another Ultra Beast has made its way to Alola, and the Ultra Guardians have an ultra-gigantic mission on their hands!
Everybody's looking forward to a relaxing day at a health spa, although a few secretly have different plans!
Things are not right in Alola, and our heroes are poised to find out why!
A mysterious creature has emerged from an Ultra Wormhole and now appears to be threatening Alola, but our heroes are ready to do anything they can to help!

eps.t: The Prism Between Light and Darkness!
eps.ov: Our heroes are on a mission to rescue Solgaleo from UB Black's clutches, and what a mission it is turning out to be!
The Ultra Guardians are on a mission to save Poipole's world, and everyone and everything depends on them!
The rumors are true, and our heroes can't pika-believe what they find!
It's time for the Masked Royal to face his old rival in the ring, but first, there are a few obstacles to be dealt with!
The Pokémon School class is putting on a play with more twists and turns than they could ever expect!
Harper and Sarah are excited to visit a haunted house, and they end up having a bit too much fun!
Some unusual activity is occurring around Wela Volcano, but the Ultra Guardians are on the case!
While Ash runs an errand to Aether Paradise, a certain trio of troublemakers sets out to catch Pokémon there!
A chance meeting with another Trainer gives Ash and Rowlet new battle experiences they never imagined!
Rotom Dex's love of the hit TV show Alolan Detective Laki produces some unexpected results!

eps.t: We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!
eps.ov: An ocean-loving Eevee has traveled many miles…and where one journey ends, another is about to begin!
A spur-of-the-moment battle with Tapu Koko results in an unexpected, unbelievable journey for Ash and Pikachu!
Our heroes are grappling with an Alola region in a parallel world-and they've appeared just in time to help save it!
At the start of their break, the Pokémon School students have visitors-and Ash can't believe his eyes!

eps.t: Heart of Fire, Heart of Stone!
eps.ov: Brock and Misty continue to enjoy their Alola region vacation, but there are some who would like that to stop!
Our heroes are visiting Poni Island for their school research projects, but they're not the only ones with big plans!
Ash's research project is all about battling, but who will that battling involve?
As the Pokémon School class continues their research projects on Poni Island, Sophocles and Lana have some big surprises in store!
Our heroes' research projects continue on Poni Island, and now is the time for Kiawe and Mallow to shine!
A visit to Hapu's farm envelops our heroes in an experience they will never forget!
The Pokémon School students have one more research project to complete, and it's sure to generate excitement and electricity for everyone!

eps.t: Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!
eps.ov: When the Pokémon School class meets an accomplished Pokémon Golfer, they learn some valuable lessons and have fun at the same time!
Our heroes have made an incredible discovery, and they're just beginning to digest the details!
Our heroes have discovered a new species of Pokémon named Meltan, and one Meltan in particular has discovered a new friend!
An appearance on a TV quiz show leads our heroes into a world they only dreamed of!
Alola is facing another crisis, and the Ultra Guardians are facing a double shift!
Professor Kukui's big announcement is making unexpected waves with unexpected people!
An emotional look into the past reveals astounding people and places, and nothing will ever be the same again!
Our heroes' visit to a popular tourist attraction ends up being anything but a breeze!
A second day in Malie City provides our heroes with a hard-earned chance for some unexpected excitement!
Sophocles may be excited to compete in a favorite race, but winning is about much more than coming in first!

eps.t: The One That Didn't Get Away!
eps.ov: What starts as an ordinary fishing expedition turns into a much bigger adventure than anyone could have imagined!
When Mallow sets out on a routine errand, little does she know she'll return with much more than she ever dreamed of!
One of Team Rocket's questionable claims comes back to haunt them when they're paid a visit by Giovanni's assistant Matori!
Our heroes can't wait to start training for the upcoming Alola Pokémon League, but not everyone is feeling confident!
Objects are being cut into pieces all over Melemele Island, and the Ultra Guardians set out to investigate!
An unexpected encounter with an unexpected Pokémon takes Ash on an adventure he'll never forget!
While Ash was caught up in an untimely adventure, his Pokémon were having quite an adventure of their own!
The Alola Pokémon League is off to a rousing start, and emotions are running high in and out of Manalo Stadium!
The Alola Pokémon League is gearing up for a thrilling opening, but there seems to be trouble ahead.
The Alola Pokémon League is off to a rousing start with a Battle Royal competition among friends and rivals both old and new!
As the Alola Pokémon League marches on, friends and rivals alike give it their all!

eps.t: The Battlefield of Truth and Love!
eps.ov: The Alola Pokémon League is in full swing, and there's no shortage of surprises in store!

eps.t: Imitation Is the Sincerest Form of Strategy!
eps.ov: As Ash and Rowlet prepare for their battle against Hau in the Alola Pokémon League, they get a little help from some old friends!
As the Alola Pokémon League quarterfinals continue, Ash and Rowlet's battle against Hau and Decidueye takes plenty of twists and turns!
The Alola Pokémon League quarterfinals are wrapping up, and today's event promises to be a wild ride!
The first match of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals is up next, and the final four Trainers are determined to come out on top!
As the Alola Pokémon League nears the finals, the stakes are getting higher, and temperatures are rising to a fever pitch!
The second round of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals is proceeding at a rapid pace, and there's a lot more going on than meets the eye!
It's time for the Alola Pokémon League finals, and the competitors are more determined than ever to become Champion!
The Alola Pokémon League is down to the final moments of the final battle! Who will emerge victorious?
Although the Alola Pokémon League is over, a new type of excitement is just beginning!
The Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match is off to a fiery start-just as expected for a battle between Ash and the now-unmasked Masked Royal!
In the air or on the ground, the Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui is roaring along!
The exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui continues with a long-awaited fiery showdown!
Ash's win at the Alola Pokémon League was astounding-but the resulting exhibition match has some colossal surprises in store, too!

eps.t: Dreaming of the Sun and Moon!
eps.ov: Now that the Alola Pokémon League is over, it's time for the Pokémon School class to make plans for their upcoming vacation!

eps.t: Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!
eps.ov: With their big vacation on the horizon, our heroes are setting some life-changing plans into motion!
